title: The Fish That Kept Growing | Matsya and Manu

lines.text: A tiny fish begged a king to save it. That fish was God.
lines.caps: A tiny *fish | begged a *king to save it. | That fish was *God.

lines.text: King Satyavrata was offering water to the gods in a river, when a small fish swam into his hands.
lines.caps: King *Satyavrata | offered water in a *river. | A *small fish swam into his hands.

lines.text: The fish said: save me from the bigger fish. The king took pity and put it in a small pot.
lines.caps: *Save me | from the bigger fish. | He put it in a *small pot.

lines.text: But the fish kept growing. The pot was too small, so he moved it to a pond, then a lake, then a river, then the sea.
lines.caps: It kept *growing. | A *pond. A *lake. | A *river. The *sea.

lines.text: The king understood this was no ordinary fish. He bowed and asked: who are you?
lines.caps: This was no *ordinary fish. | He *bowed and asked: | who are *you?

lines.text: Vishnu, as a giant golden fish, said: in seven days the world will drown in a flood.
lines.caps: *Vishnu | as a golden fish: | in *seven days | the world will *drown.

lines.text: A great boat will come. Load it with seeds, herbs, animals, and the seven sages.
lines.caps: A great *boat will come. | Load *seeds, herbs, | animals and the *seven sages.

lines.text: When the flood came, the boat appeared. The king tied it to the fish's horn, using the serpent Vasuki as a rope.
lines.caps: The *flood came. | He tied the boat | to the *horn, | with *Vasuki as the rope.

lines.text: Through the dark waters, the fish pulled the boat, and taught the king deep wisdom as they travelled.
lines.caps: Through the dark *waters, | the fish *pulled the boat | and taught *wisdom.

lines.text: He also destroyed the demon Hayagriva, who had stolen the sacred Vedas, and brought them back.
lines.caps: He destroyed *Hayagriva, | who *stole the Vedas, | and brought them *back.

lines.text: The king became Manu, the father of a new age. Follow for more stories.
lines.caps: The king became *Manu, | father of a *new age. | Follow for *more stories.
